purpose: Remove DrvFs small-file I/O overhead while keeping benchmark data physically on the external SSD

source.filesystem_access: Windows external SSD exposed to WSL through DrvFs

verification.method: sorted per-file SHA-256 manifests compared with diff; aggregate SHA-256 recorded below

benchmark_policy.persistent_input: external SSD canonical source, with the ext4 copy retained as an independently verified byte-identical mirror
benchmark_policy.runtime_input: transient tmpfs copy created from the external SSD before timed runs
benchmark_policy.runtime_copy_verification: compare the tmpfs per-file SHA-256 manifest with the frozen source manifest before odometry starts
benchmark_policy.cache_policy: three full-sequence runs from the same verified tmpfs copy; staging time is excluded
